searchText: Akula is your best friend from now on (or Erigon if you don't care about Rust) <@329594653097721856> If Gray Glacier is done like all other diff bomb delays, can't OE simply be configured for it in chain config? You can provably fiddle with defusion, and then a few months later Ethereum moves to PoS and you are in the same situation just more so. It’s time to move to an EL that will support merged mainnet. I'm still curious if a simple config tweak will make it work if they use a custom chain config, it seems pretty doable -- this is the PR that added Arrow Glacier it to the default chain config: https://github.com/openethereum/openethereum/pull/561 Oh, right, the PR reveals that it's also necessary to add the fork id I'll try to add the diff bomb delay in hive, lets see if it passes consensus tests
